## TASK-001 - Freeze current scope, editions and owner prerequisites

Before implementation, inspect current governing bytes, exact root and source/Template package inventories, Git mixed work, selected health inputs and existing operation owners. Freeze authorized source/root/destination manifests and requested operation grants with preservation snapshots. Identify current function ownership, root charter/governance/config coherence, and any exact necessary documentation correction. Freeze licensing, authored ontology/memory, disabled preferences, original receipts, current registry and unselected project inventories. Preserve prior guard repair results as dated prerequisite evidence.

## TASK-002 - Specify Curator semantics and adoption transaction

Define one complete integration edition and competency matrix before code. Bind each Curator function to installed sources, typed inputs/outputs, owner, affected scope, prerequisites and evaluation triggers. Specify neutral recipe specialization and the exact current-owner setup/publication transaction. Define stable suffixes, predicate domain/range/cardinality, source locators and the complete operation contract. Initial empty/pristine installation remains under the setup owner; existing authored ontology uses the ontology owner within the same selected setup workflow. Freeze grant validation and lock ordering across setup, ontology and Template owners before implementation.

### Risks

- Core-only loader and neutral empty graph rules are current constraints, not permission to add unsupported imports.

### Acceptance criteria

- Matrix covers policy status/validate, scoped review, owner-routed update/correct, retry/recovery, Task pause/resume, selected tick, session catch-up and all bounded log routes.
- The design defines source schema, edition/digests, exact config/graph selection, setup receipt linkage, current-owner grant inputs and interrupted-operation states.
- All agent-selected packaging, IDs, interfaces and edition values remain proposed until the exact implementation baseline is accepted.
- One reviewed transaction contract defines preflight, finalized source binding, preview, immutable intent, config/graph replacements, linked receipt, setup verification and exact partial recovery. It defines lock order and read behavior during a partially installed config without promising cross-system atomicity.
- Historical setup editions, partial operations, current actor ownership, session/capture/publication opt-outs and source/target conflicts each have an explicit outcome. Missing required authority or capability remains a hold, without weakening protected scopes.

### Planned verification

- Compare every matrix row with curate ACTIONS/commands/session contract and ontology owner semantics.
- Walk all 34 TRD clauses against proposed artifacts and routes; check no imported-core mutation or copied root actor is needed.
